title: Verify provenance
description: The provenance blob of every Verify script: which tasks ran together, on which platform, with which wasmtime and runtime module, at which degree, and what each task cost (fuel, peak memory, wall time). It does not say which machine ran what. A record, not an identity (fuel drifts between hosts, wall times vary).

batches.description: One entry per execution of a batch, ordered by first task index; a batch that ran twice has two.

controller.description: The controller version that ran the batch.

degree.description: Concurrent sandboxes the batch ran at.

wall_ms.description: Wall time of the whole batch on the node.

fuel.description: Fuel the batch's tasks consumed in total.

tasks.description: Task indices of the batch, ascending.

metrics.description: One record per task of the batch, in the order of `tasks`: what the task cost on this node. Fuel is reproducible on a host (the cap for a Timeout) but drifts between hosts for CPython tasks; wall time is hardware.
